review: Independent final review of offline bundled pip bootstrap repair and Windows configuration correction

accepted_boundaries.assessment: One locked pip package exactly matches bootstrap dependency group. Locked URL must identify universal pip wheel on files.pythonhosted.org. Cached/downloaded content must match exact SHA256 and size before staging. Export includes bootstrap group with locked hashed requirements. Manifest includes bootstrap identity and wheel hash.

Manifest requires exact safe bootstrap basename and exact three-file inventory plus manifest; verifies each SHA256 before runtime setup. Full manifest fingerprint changes runtime directory identity, invalidating old ready runtimes.

First installer operation is offline no-index/no-deps against manifest-verified local pip wheel; later commands invoke patched installed pip for hashed binary application dependencies, offline ownwheel, and dependency check. Existing disable-version-check and Python isolated mode remain. Corrected PIP_CONFIG_FILE exactly matches Python os.devnull on Windows and POSIX, so isolated mode cannot retain global/site pip configuration.
bootstrap pip==26.2.1; uv.lock contains matching wheel SHA256 71138adf1f4ca900cdb7d289c21b7494329f2332b6d85f0e1c42108c0384ed3e and size1816632. Version is above all six prior advisory fixes.
